control_flow: Start: forever call the function followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker reads below 30 % (black), curve left; else if it reads above 70 % (white band or peach floor), curve right; else drive forward at 20 %.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line from the start, through its curves, to the green goal at its end, without leaving it.

decision_points.condition: first: the line tracker reads less than 30 % (black); second: it reads more than 70 % (bright floor)

branches.outcome: the floor reads below 30 % (black line): it curves left
no black, the floor reads above 70 % (white band or peach): it curves right

branches.reason: A reading between 30 % and 70 % only happens at the edge of the black core, for a moment, so a run may cross it without the program reading it.
branches.outcome: no black and not bright (30 % to 70 %): it drives forward

input_dimensions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left on black (below 30 %), curves right on bright floor (above 70 %), and drives forward in between.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on the middle of the black line, facing along it, in bright light; the line runs through curves and ends at a green goal area.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker reads the black core, then the floor beside it, again and again.
scenarios.title: Follows the line through its curves to the goal
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line from the start, through its curves, to the goal at its end, without leaving it.

uncertainties: The program curves right on a plain floor (83 %): without the line under it, it circles without getting anywhere, so it needs the line to follow.
The in-between branch (30 % to 70 %) only happens at the edge of the black core, for a moment: a run may or may not read it.
You said 'without leaving it': while following the line the robot wiggles across the black core's edge, so 'leaving' is not a sharp event.

planned: On the line, it follows it to the goal

outcomes.words: condition 2 holds (the ones before it don't)
planned: On the line, it follows it to the goal

outcomes.words: no condition holds: the else part runs

worlds.name: A curved line to the goal

tests.name: On the line, it follows it to the goal
tests.scenario: Given the robot starts on the line at A, when the program runs, then it follows the line through its curves and reaches Goal 1 at its end without bumping into anything.

equivalence_partitions.selected_realization: A, on the line's first point, facing along it
equivalence_partitions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line

expected_results: It follows the line through its curves and reaches Goal 1 at the line's end.

postconditions.description: By the end of the run, the robot has touched Goal 1.
During the whole run, it never bumps into anything.

tests.reason: Following the line from the start to the goal is what you said.

job.sentence: Follow the black line from the start all the way to the green goal at its end, also through the curves, without leaving it.
